# Syntheon Hub

> AI project management that joins your meetings, extracts action items, and creates organized tickets automatically.

## Product
Syntheon Hub (also called Syntheon AI) is a web application at https://syntheonhub.com.
The app lives at https://app.syntheonhub.com.

Syntheon Hub sends a bot into Google Meet, Zoom, or Microsoft Teams meetings. After the call, AI extracts implementation-ready tickets (title, description, priority, labels, assignee, due dates, dependencies) onto a Kanban board with sprints, analytics, and organization/role management.

## Key capabilities
- Meeting bot for Google Meet, Zoom, Microsoft Teams
- Automatic transcript → ticket extraction
- Kanban board with filtering and bulk actions
- Hard/soft ticket dependencies and dependency graph
- Sprint-stones, burndown, velocity, cycle time, milestones
- Organizations, invites, domain verification, roles
- Integrations (GitHub, Google Calendar)

## Plans
Every plan starts with a 7-day free trial. Free and paid organization plans are available from the app. Contact support@syntheonhub.com for enterprise questions.
